purpose: Index of the retained runs of the mutation driver for tests/test_frozen_macos_variant_no_use.py (PR #635): round 8's final run and round 9's three control runs against the retained earlier modules, whose rows evidence/receipts/dependabot-alert-16-dismissal-20261003.json reports in guard_mutation_checks.
evidence_class: Local fault injection with synthetic scenario fixtures, run in scratch clones on one host: not an upstream harness, and not run in CI. Each mutant writes scenario files into a scratch clone, runs python3 -m unittest tests.test_frozen_macos_variant_no_use there and restores the clone; nothing was installed, built or served.

driver.origin: The round-6 driver (sha256 5fff1fa7c6323b059b778fc6ed1478f42b54e19d4d63d7f5e85640a81f336f2e, not retained) with three edits: M9's artifact directory name is assembled from fragments as PARENT's is, PARENT's comment is reworded and the docstring gains a round-7 sentence. Loading both drivers and recording every mutant's file operations gave the same calls for all 45 (the two that read the clone or run git were compared by source).

controls.note: The earlier modules the control runs used, byte for byte (module_file_sha256 equals each run's module_sha256). They are kept as .txt files under evidence/** with Git mode 100644, no leading #! and no client configuration directory in their path, so the guard's recogniser does not read them and their lines naming the artifact are not referencing lines; nothing runs them. To rebuild a control: check out main's d2777ee7, copy the module to tests/test_frozen_macos_variant_no_use.py, commit, and run the driver with the run's ids.

placeholders.<repo>: the owned checkout of PR #635's branch, from which the driver ran at its repository path; every run used the same driver file (driver_sha256)
placeholders.<clone>: the run's scratch clone (its root directory)
placeholders.<out>: the run's scratch output directory, whose files the run's subdirectory here holds
placeholders.<python>: the Python installation's prefix, which tracebacks name

sanitization: Each copied file had every occurrence of its run's clone root replaced with <clone>, of the run's output directory with <out> and of the Python installation's prefix with <python> (counts in each run's replacements); nothing else was changed. An empty stderr was not copied (stderr_bytes). After the copy, a recursive grep of this directory for the host's home and temporary directory prefixes and its user name printed nothing.
